arguments.old_text:
left join orders o on ol.order_id = o.order_id
group by 1, 2
arguments.new_text:
join orders o on ol.order_id = o.order_id
where o.status != 'CANCELLED'
  and coalesce(o.test_order_flag, false) = false
group by 1, 2

arguments.sql: select count(*) n_rows, count(distinct category||'|'||cast(sales_month as varchar)) grain_keys, sum(revenue) rev, sum(units_sold) units, sum(gross_profit) gp, sum(case when sales_month is null then 1 else 0 end) null_rows from main.rpt_category_performance

select sum(ol.line_total) rev, sum(ol.quantity_ordered) units from main.stg_orders__order_lines ol join main.stg_orders__orders o on o.order_id=ol.order_id where o.status <> 'CANCELLED' and coalesce(o.test_order_flag,false)=false

root_cause.summary: The mart summed revenue, units, orders and gross profit over every order line, including CANCELLED orders and test orders (TEST_ORDER_FLAG = true). It also used LEFT JOINs from products to orders, so rows with no order date (sales_month NULL, orders 0) appeared in the report. Cancelled and test orders are not sales, so the monthly category figures were overstated.

evidence.ref: main.stg_orders__order_lines joined to main.stg_orders__orders, grouped by status and TEST_ORDER_FLAG
evidence.finding: CANCELLED orders had 142 orders and about 54.1k of line_total, and test orders were also present across statuses. The original report included all of them.

evidence.ref: live SQL of rpt_category_performance, rows with o.ordered_at IS NULL
evidence.finding: 183 rows had no order match. They produced NULL sales_month groups, including PHYSICAL with 2,950.78 of revenue from orphan-order lines, plus product-only rows with no sales.
No duplicate keys. The join fan-out is clean, and the source totals of 722,313.24 revenue and 6,590 units reconcile to the old report. So the issue is which lines count, not a join multiplication.

195 rows with unique category and month keys, no NULL sales_month rows, revenue 657,959.9716 and units 6,022. An independent sum over non-cancelled, non-test order lines gives 657,959.9716 and 6,022, so the figures match the source.
The model reads only four staging views (order_lines, orders, products, product_variants). No upstream model was changed.

changes.summary: Changed the orders join from LEFT to inner and added a WHERE clause that excludes CANCELLED orders and test orders (coalesce(test_order_flag,false)=false). This removes the NULL-month rows and keeps revenue, units, orders and gross profit to real, non-test sales. Output columns, grain (category x month) and view materialization are unchanged.
